meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau / HUD, American Housing Survey 2023 National PUF v1.1 (flat CSV ahs2023n.csv), https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/ahs/2023/AHS%202023%20National%20PUF%20v1.1%20Flat%20CSV.zip ; value labels https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/ahs/2023/AHS%202023%20Value%20Labels%20Package.zip
meta.method: Weighted shares (WEIGHT) among units with a valid answer (not applicable/not reported excluded). SE in percentage points from the 160 Fay replicate weights: variance = (4/160) * sum((rep-full)^2), as in the AHS Quick Guide to Estimating Variance Using Replicate Weights. Cells are [share_pct, se_pp, unweighted_units_in_category]. n = unweighted valid-answer units; band suppressed if n<30.
meta.universe: All housing units in the 50 states and DC in the 2023 national sample, including occupied and vacant (year-round) units; YRBUILT is respondent/enumerator reported decade for units built before 2010 (exact year for 2010+ grouped here as 2010 or later). Reflects surviving stock and the home as it is today.
meta.region_note: Regions derived from AHS DIVISION: Northeast=1,2; Midwest=3,4; South=5,6,7; West=8,9.

caveats: Census Bureau working paper 2011-18 (Sarkar): "current residents of these homes report the size and other characteristics of the home; and in the case of older homes, some of the home characteristics ... may have been more recent additions or installations and did not come with the home when it was originally built."
AHS has no roof or exterior-wall material variable (only roof/wall condition items); use RECS for those.
